artworks.title: Self-Portrait and the Artist's Brother
artworks.artist: Antoine Marie Philippe Louis d' Orléans, duc de Montpensier
artworks.description: The image shows a side-by-side profile view of a person with short hair on the top and sides and longer hair at the back, tied in a small ponytail. They have a prominent nose and distinct sideburns, wearing a high-collared, double-breasted coat with a wide lapel and a ruffled shirt visible underneath. There is a faint inscription at the bottom center that reads "A. B. O. fecit 1805."

artworks.title: Hudson River Portfolio: Looking South from Battery Knox, West Point
artworks.artist: Charles Parsons after Benjamin Bellows Grant Stone
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on Chine appliquee paper
artworks.description: This image shows the Hudson River from Battery Knox, West Point, facing south. The horizon is in the upper third of the image, where hills and sky meet. The river widens in the middle, flowing into the distance. Several sailboats and steamboats are visible on the water near the horizon. On the right, a large building sits among trees on a hill. A pathway follows the riverbank, with three figures nearby; one seated and the others talking. The brushstrokes are detailed, creating a realistic landscape. The color palette is muted, with greens, browns, and blues capturing the tranquil scene under a partly cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Voltaire
artworks.artist: Louise Marguerite Espérance Langlois after P. Periaux
artworks.description: The image displays a full-length profile of a person standing. The person faces right with a slightly angled body. He has distinct facial features including a prominent nose and softly closed mouth. The person's hair is styled in long, curly 18th-century fashion. He is dressed in an elaborately detailed coat, knee-length breeches, and stockings. Black shoes are on his feet, and he holds an ornate walking cane in his right hand. The background features a serene outdoor scene with a calm body of water, trees, and mountains or hills.

artworks.title: The Farmyard
artworks.medium: etching and roulette on chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a village scene in a rural setting. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, capturing a cluster of buildings. On the left, there is a building with a slanted, textured roof and an ornate window. Moving right, the buildings extend towards a round-arched entrance with what appears to be a tower. An archway shows a human figure, adding depth to the scene. The rooftops dominate the upper section of the composition, and the etching technique uses fine lines and cross-hatching for shadows and textures. The color palette is a sepia tone. In the foreground, small human figures are engaged in activities, and a tree with leaves is on the right.

artworks.title: The Big Shower
artworks.medium: etching and roulette on chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene from an aerial perspective, lightly tilted for visual interest. A faint horizon divides the water and sky. The piece is created with fine linear brushstrokes and crosshatching, giving texture. The color scheme is brown-toned. In the foreground, a small boat with three figures, one holding an umbrella, is present. The boat appears to be rowing or observing. Further out, the water's surface is calm. A single tree is depicted off to one side, balancing the boat in the serene aquatic landscape.

artworks.title: The Shed with Children Fighting
artworks.medium: etching and roulette on chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a farmhouse, a figure near barrels, and children playing. The shelter has a thatched roof and the background includes coniferous trees and clouds in a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: The Young Peasant Woman
artworks.medium: etching and roulette on chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a riverbank viewed from the side. There are tall trees on the left side, with decreasing height and density towards the background. A man is sitting by the river holding a fishing rod. The horizon is low, just above the river, creating a line towards the fisherman. The background has soft, horizontal lines hinting at distant land or water. The image uses an etching technique with fine lines and hatching for depth. The color scheme is monochromatic, emphasizing contrasts between dark and light areas to convey tranquility.

artworks.title: A Heath
artworks.medium: etching and roulette on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features a landscape seen from an elevated perspective, showcasing an open expanse with a low horizon, faint objects in the distance, two trees on the left, and textured grassy ground. The vast sky is filled with voluminous clouds, all depicted in shades of gray.

artworks.title: The Small Shepherd Seated
artworks.medium: etching and roulette on chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with rolling hills, clusters of trees, and a textured sky. The artwork shows detailed line work for foliage and clouds, suggesting an etching technique. A figure sits beneath tree branches. The scene is monochrome, with varying shades of black and white. In the distance, smaller hills and trees can be seen under an elaborate cloud-filled sky.

artworks.title: The Tourist
artworks.medium: etching and roulette on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with fine etching techniques. A figure stands on an elevated slope, using a telescope. The slope extends upwards to the left with two trees, and the horizon line is seen above the midpoint with distant treetops. The sky has horizontally etched lines representing clouds. The color palette is monochromatic using shades of black and grey.

artworks.title: View of Santron
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a large, leafy tree slightly to the left on a gentle slope. In the background, there are smaller trees blending into the sky. The brushstrokes are intricate with detailed textures in the bark and leaves of the trees. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black, white, and gray. Two small figures are visible in the distance, interacting with each other among a cluster of trees. The background has softly rendered clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Outdoor Cafe Scene
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines and patches of color that form an abstract representation. The artwork conveys motion and energy, resembling a busy café or social gathering. The blurred forms suggest people seated around tables, with circular shapes resembling hats or trays, and vertical strokes symbolizing figures sat upright.

artworks.title: Femme a la torque ornee (Woman with a plumed hat)
artworks.description: The image features a figure with a head and upper body of a woman and the lower half of a mermaid, displayed against a plain background. The figure shows a reclining or swimming position, with the mermaid tail curving upwards. The woman's face has delicate features and a contemplative expression. Her hair is styled and adorned with a headpiece featuring feathers. The clothing includes a dark bodice extending into the tail, which has a detailed, textured appearance. No visible jewelry or objects are present.

artworks.title: The Tournament Place in the City of Zwickau
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval city scene. The drawing depicts a circular arena or amphitheater filled with figures engaged in various activities. Surrounding the arena is an urban landscape with detailed illustrations of buildings and churches. The drawing includes labeled elements, suggesting a narrative intent. Activities inside the arena may showcase performances or competitions. The work features detailed linework and a busy composition typical of 16th-century engravings.

artworks.title: Clement de Jonghe
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and burin on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an etching of a person seated on a wooden chair. The person is facing forward with both arms resting, the left arm slightly higher than the right. They have a calm expression with defined facial features, including eyes, a nose, and slightly opened lips. Their shoulder-length wavy hair is partially visible under a wide-brimmed hat casting a shadow on the face. The person is wearing a buttoned shirt with a visible collar and a draped cloak, showing folds and texture. There is no visible jewelry or items held by the person. The background is plain with minimal etching lines, focusing on the person as the central subject.

artworks.title: Sick Woman with a Large White Headdress (Saskia)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 x 5.2 cm (2 1/2 x 2 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of an older woman sitting with her head slightly turned to the left. She has facial features showing signs of age, such as wrinkles, and a somber expression. Her hair is mostly covered by a cloth, possibly a hat or headscarf. She is wearing bulky or layered clothing with folds and textures. There are no visible accessories. The background is plain with cross-hatched lines.

artworks.title: Allegory of Carnal Love
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures set against a natural backdrop. The drawing features a group of six figures, along with two smaller figures, who appear to be in a garden or wooded setting. The figures are depicted in various poses, some with arms raised. Around them, trees with sparse foliage frame the scene, and clouds are visible in the sky. The engraving is detailed, with careful attention to the human form and drapery. The scene is bustling with life, creating a lively tableau with dynamic interactions between the figures and their surroundings.

artworks.title: Cover Design
artworks.description: The image features a square area in the top right corner with an abstract design of fluid, squiggly lines. The design resembles a snake and is accompanied by the text "PIERRE ROCHE TROIS GYPSOGRAPHIES." The rest of the image is a blank, pale background, emphasizing the contrasting texture and design within the square.

artworks.title: Aphrodite
artworks.description: The image depicts a nude woman standing upright. One arm is raised, touching her hair, while the other rests by her side. Her facial features are indistinct in the artistic style. Her hair is long and wavy. The woman has no visible clothing or jewelry and is surrounded by ocean waves. Birds fly around her in the sky, which is a mix of orange and blue tones. The background shows abstract forms creating a seascape setting with a textured appearance.

artworks.title: Colosses de Memnon (Thebes)
artworks.description: This is a painting of two indistinct figures sitting in a desert landscape beneath a vast sky. The painting depicts a broad expanse of land that features two dark, seated forms that are abstract in nature against a warm, orange horizon line that contrasts with the pale, largely unembellished sky above. The area directly beneath the figures is textured with horizontal strokes in muted earthy tones, suggesting an uneven, possibly arid terrain.

artworks.title: Danseuse Cobodgienne (Cambodian Dancer)
artworks.description: This is a painting of an abstract figure in a seated, cross-legged pose. The figure is predominantly rendered in white against a textured, earthy brown background. The figure's arms are symmetrically outstretched upwards and sideways. The figure appears to be wearing an ornate headpiece or crown. Surrounding the figure is a subtle, flowing line. The painting has a minimalist aesthetic with a focus on shape and form.

artworks.title: Diane au levrier (Diana and a Greyhound)
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length representation of a nude figure in profile, standing with one arm raised and the other lowered. The figure's facial features are indistinct due to the style of the artwork, and the hair appears to be short or sculpted closely to the head. The figure is holding an unidentified form or possibly drapery with the lower hand, and there is a flowing form extending from the raised arm. No clothing or jewelry is visible as the figure is nude. Around the figure, there is a textured, reddish-brown background that contrasts with the lighter shade of the body. The image is framed within a rectangular border on paper, and the rest of the background is a plain, light-colored paper with some handwritten text near the bottom.

artworks.title: Femme et Cygne, 22 fevrier 1912, Diner Japonaise (Woman and Bird, 22 February 1912, J
artworks.description: The image shows a stylized drawing of a woman in profile, with her full body visible in a sitting position. Her legs are bent, and she is wearing a wide-brimmed hat. She is wearing a form-fitting dress, and there are abstract shapes around her. The text includes "22 Février 1918" and "Diner Japonais," all embossed in the same style as the drawing. In the bottom right corner, there is a small emblem with the letter "R" inside. The background is a light, uniform color.

artworks.title: Notre Dame du Folgoet (Our Lady of Folgoet)
artworks.description: The image shows abstract forms including a vertical rectangle on the left with the text "O DITROUN GUERHEZ MARI" and a textured area in the center with a human-like figure. The design resembles a statue-like figure of a woman holding a child, both wearing detailed crowns. Draped lines suggest robes, similar to traditional religious iconography. The shading and texture create depth and dimension, resembling embossed or relief-style art.
